title: Tuesday Daily Practice
subtitle: Review B7: new words, he/she -s, doesn't and Does, how often
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 5 (B7 Other people's habits, B8 Putting it all together + Phase A test), Tue 10 Nov (review B7)
intro: Six steps, about 60 minutes. Deadline: 23:00 the same day. Step 5 is writing: type it in the box on the website. Step 6 is a voice note. Book work: do EPIU 42.1 and 42.2 in your book and send a photo in the Zalo group.

steps.title: Step 1 · Lesson 7 words
steps.instructions: Choose the correct word or phrase.

items.q: 1. My grandpa goes to bed at 9 p.m. and gets up at 4 a.m. He is ____.
2. I ____ breakfast because I am never hungry in the morning.
3. Every Saturday my dad ____ in the garden. The grass is short now.
4. She sits quietly and ____ for ten minutes every morning.
5. We ____ paper and plastic bottles at home.
6. He plays games on his phone for 8 hours a day. He is ____ his phone.

steps.title: Step 2 · Web words from Monday
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with one of Monday's 20 words on the website.

items.label: 1. I have a ____ on Sunday. I get up at ten. (l)
2. I hit ____ three times, so I am late. (s)
3. She is always ____. She is never late for class. (p)
4. I ____ and missed the bus this morning. (o)
5. Please ____ up your desk before you leave. (t)

steps.title: Step 3 · Grammar: he, she, it
steps.instructions: Write the correct form of the verb. Use doesn't or Does where you see (not) or (?).

items.label: 3. She ____ a short video before bed. (watch)
4. He ____ a shower in the morning. (have)
7. ____ your dad mow the lawn on Sunday? (?)
8. What time ____ she go to bed? (?)

options.A: I always stay up late on Friday.
options.B: I stay always up late on Friday.
options.C: I stay up late always on Friday.

items.q: 5. How often does he mow the lawn? — ____

steps.title: Step 5 · Writing: one person at home
steps.instructions: Write 5 sentences about the habits of one person in your family. You must use: 2 Lesson 7 words, 1 sentence with doesn't, 1 sentence with always, usually, often, sometimes or never. Type it in the box on the website.

open.model: My dad is an early bird. He always wakes up at five. He meditates for ten minutes. He doesn't skip breakfast. On Sunday, he mows the lawn.

ai.type: Short paragraph about another person's habits
ai.task: Write 5 sentences about one family member's habits with 2 Lesson 7 words, 1 sentence with doesn't and 1 frequency adverb.
criteria: 5 complete sentences with a capital letter and a full stop
uses he or she with the -s / -es / -ies ending correctly
has at least 1 correct sentence with doesn't + base verb
uses a frequency adverb in the correct position
uses at least two Lesson 7 words

steps.title: Step 6 · Voice note: Hoa's routine
steps.instructions: Read Hoa's routine aloud 3 times, slowly. Record one voice note.
lines: 1. My friend Hoa is a very busy student.
2. She wakes up at six o'clock.
3. She makes breakfast for her little brother.
4. Then she goes to school by bike.
5. In the evening, she studies English and watches a short video.
6. She usually goes to bed at half past ten.
7. On Sunday, she does the laundry and cleans her room.
8. She likes her routine because it keeps her healthy.
steps.note: Teacher listens for the endings: wakes /s/, makes /s/, goes /z/, studies /z/, watches /ɪz/, does /z/.

send_today: Six steps on the website. Voice note in step 6 is sent to the teacher when you press Submit. Photo of EPIU 42.1 and 42.2 in the Zalo group: Done + name + Tuesday.
